 NEW DELHI: Reliance Jio on Wednesday launched an ultra-affordable unlimited 5G data plan priced at ₹15.
The plan offers high-capacity data on demand to subscribers for 24 hours, enabling them to enjoy use cases such as ultra HD and 4K movie streaming, lag-free gaming, seamless cloud backups, hotspot tethering, and heavy application and content downloads.
 The ₹15 truly unlimited 5G data plan is now live and can be activated instantly across all recharge platforms, payment partners, and retail outlets nationwide.
